_comment: Per-file coverage thresholds enforced by scripts/coverage-perfile.mjs. Defaults apply to every file under src/{engine,game}/*.mjs (excluding test-hooks.mjs and api.mjs). Files in 'overrides' lower the floor with a documented reason. NEW files automatically inherit defaults: any new file added to src/ that ships below the defaults will fail the gate.

src/engine/loop.mjs._reason: small public surface; one untested admin path drops fn% disproportionately

src/engine/renderer.mjs._reason: defensive canvas-mock branches not exercised in jsdom-style harness

src/game/invaders.mjs._reason: consumeFireCadence dead branches — gated on issue #35 (formation.tryFire accumulator bug)

src/game/main.mjs._reason: boot-time/storage error recovery paths run only in real browser; covered by e2e-local

src/game/player.mjs._reason: defensive guards on null inputs from caller

src/game/scenes/gameover.mjs._reason: trivial scene; per-event-type handlers split branch counts

src/game/scenes/menu.mjs._reason: trivial scene; per-event-type handlers split branch counts

src/game/scenes/play.mjs._reason: complex scene; explicit ratchet to keep this file rigorously tested

src/engine/audio.mjs._reason: not loaded by production; Web Audio mock in unit only

src/engine/collision.mjs._reason: polygon helpers dead in production; unit covers 100/84/100/100
